searchText: Update: Pyrmont is back to 100%! Thanks to eth2 client teams working around the clock However, we discovered various things that we will want to update in clients. So expect some more volatility in participation rates, as clients roll out their fixes Quick update for Nimbus: we had a pruning issue on finality when there were many late blocks that would cause the nodes to branch off to their histories - a fix has been pushed out - we're investigating the eth1 voting issue and should have a fix ready soon as well Update: we are redeploying some EF nodes and switching back to Teku and Nimbus nodes with newest updates. we're we're also redeploying some infra, expect a few missed blocks as they restart Update, expect 95% or lower for a little while, moving 5% chunks of validators to new nodes

excerpts.author: protolambda
excerpts.content: Update: we are redeploying some EF nodes and switching back to Teku and Nimbus nodes with newest updates.
